title: DIO time projection beyond u32 range must invalidate DIO advertisement with diagnostic (spec 09 14.6)
description: Spec 09 14.6 R-09-109: projection beyond the unsigned 32-bit DIO range MUST invalidate DIO advertisement with an observable diagnostic rather than wrap. Classification: not-implemented in all stacks. Evidence: rg for advertise/advertisement/dio_range/4294967295/u32_max across python/src/lichen/timing/ clean; no tracker-side advertisement invalidation; python DioTimeOption.encode (timing/samples.py:126-160) would raise struct.error on out-of-range unix time (crash, not diagnostic); Rust dio_time.rs/time_option.rs and C time_sync.c:604-668 encoders likewise lack a pre-encode range gate tied to tracker state. Suggested placement: tracker/provider level (python/src/lichen/timing/stratum.py + C lichen/subsys/lichen/link/time_sync.c) - invalidate DIO advertisement with an observable diagnostic when projected unix time exceeds 0xFFFFFFFF; add malformed/range vector to packets-timing.json or dio_time_option_malformed.json.
